mapper.sql: l.agent_results_json IS NOT NULL AND l.agent_results_json <> '' AND l.agent_results_json <> 'null' AND l.agent_results_json <> '{}' AND l.agent_results_json <> '[]' AND JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.images') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.images')) <> 'NULL' AND ( ( JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.images')) = 'ARRAY' AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.images')) > 0 ) OR ( JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.images')) = 'OBJECT' AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.images')) > 0 ) )

CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.images')) = 'ARRAY' THEN IFNULL(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.images')), 0) WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.images')) = 'OBJECT' AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.images')) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

where.if: AND ( l.sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

AND l.listing_platform_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.listing_platform_id) <> '' AND l.assign_owner_user_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.assign_owner_user_id) <> '' AND l.assign_image_user_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.assign_image_user_id) <> ''

mapper.sql: l.id, l.sku, l.product_name AS productName, () AS imageCount, () AS coverUrl, NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.batchNo')), '') AS batchNo, COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.generatedAt')), ''), NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.createdAt')), '') ) AS generatedAt, l.update_date AS updateDate, l.listing_platform_id AS listingPlatformId, COALESCE(p.name, p2.name) AS platformName, l.shop_id AS shopId, l.listing_category_id AS listingCategoryId, cat.name AS categoryName, l.assign_owner_user_id AS assignOwnerUserId, ou.account AS assignOwnerName, l.assign_copy_user_id AS assignCopyUserId, cu.account AS assignCopyName, l.assign_image_user_id AS assignImageUserId, iu.account AS assignImageName, l.assign_phase AS assignPhase, NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.copy.title')), '') AS copyTitle, CASE WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.copy') IS NOT NULL AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.copy')) <> 'NULL' AND ( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.copy.title')), '') IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.copy.description')), '') IS NOT NULL OR ( JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.copy.bullets')) = 'ARRAY' AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.copy.bullets')) > 0 ) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hasCopy, CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.copy.bullets')) = 'ARRAY' THEN IFNULL(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.copy.bullets')), 0) WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.copy.bulletPoints')) = 'ARRAY' THEN IFNULL(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(l.agent_results_json, '$.copy.bulletPoints')), 0) ELSE 0 END AS bulletCount

LEFT JOIN t_giga_listing_platform p ON p.id = l.listing_platform_id
LEFT JOIN t_giga_listing_category cat ON cat.id = l.listing_category_id LEFT JOIN t_giga_listing_platform p2 ON p2.id = cat.platform_id
LEFT JOIN t_user ou ON CAST(ou.id AS CHAR) = CAST(l.assign_owner_user_id AS CHAR) LEFT JOIN t_user cu ON CAST(cu.id AS CHAR) = CAST(l.assign_copy_user_id AS CHAR) LEFT JOIN t_user iu ON CAST(iu.id AS CHAR) = CAST(l.assign_image_user_id AS CHAR)
mapper.select:
SELECT , l.agent_results_json AS agentResultsJson FROM t_gigab2b_product_list l
WHERE l.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
